title: Evolve a Go todo server over 5 steps: done toggle, delete, priorities, filtering, pagination
description: A minimal Go todo server (list + create) must be evolved step by step to a production-ready API.

task_spec.prompt:
The Go todo server has GET /todos and POST /todos. Evolve it in five steps:

Step 1 — Done toggle: add PATCH /todos/{id}/done that flips the Done field and returns the updated todo (404 if missing).

Step 2 — Delete: add DELETE /todos/{id} that removes the todo from the slice and returns 204 No Content (404 if missing).

Step 3 — Priority field: add an optional Priority int field (default 0) to Todo. Update POST /todos to accept priority in the body. Write a SortByPriority helper that returns todos sorted by priority descending.

Step 4 — Filter: update GET /todos to accept an optional ?done=true|false query param. When provided, return only todos matching the done status. When absent, return all.

Step 5 — Pagination: update GET /todos to also accept ?page=N&page_size=M (1-indexed, default page_size=10). Apply pagination after the done filter. Return a JSON object {items: [...], total: N, page: N, page_size: N}.

Add tests for every new behaviour. All existing tests must continue to pass. Run go test ./... to confirm.
success_criteria: All tests green including original three
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `go test ./...` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `go test ./...` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
